_comment: The only list of the languages a build can be made in (docs/plan/I18N_PLAN.md, private).
code: VITA_LOCALE value and tools/locales/<code>/ folder. gameLanguage: LANGUAGE_* the game is
built with. romCode: 4th letter of the cartridge's game code (BPE?), null when the language has
no official cartridge. base: language of the ROM a catalog language is built on. letters: the
letters beyond ASCII and the base set (BASE_LETTERS in tools/locales/compile_ui.py) that this
language's UI fonts need; every one is baked once by tools/ui2/bake_locale_glyphs.py and only
the build's own go into its atlas. source: where the game's text comes from: none (the
sources' English), rom (the player's official cartridge, SHA-1 romSha1, through
tools/locales/<code>/manifest.json.gz and tools/locales/localize.py) or catalog (text kept in
tools/locales/<code>/, over a ROM of the base language).
units: imperial or metric, for the heights and weights the native UI shows.
